R2988.summary: Throckmorton sends a gentleman, the bearer, to report the French King's state by word of mouth after his two despatches of 8 July (by Gray and, at midnight, by Carew); he asks the Queen to give the bearer credit, praises his diverse and sundry service and asks that it be rewarded. An unpublished letter, not in Forbes or CSP Foreign.
